description: Implementation of SkiaTraceMemoryDump for tracing Skia memory usage, including methods for dumping numeric and string values, setting memory backings, and managing discardable memory.

classes.name: SkiaTraceMemoryDumpImpl
classes.description: Implementation of a memory dump class for Skia, providing methods to dump memory values, set backings, and manage discardable memory.

methods.name: SkiaTraceMemoryDumpImpl
methods.description: Constructor initializing the dump with optional prefix and detail level.

methods.name: dumpNumericValue
methods.description: Dumps a numeric memory value with a specified name, units, and value.

methods.name: dumpStringValue
methods.description: Dumps a string value with a specified name.

methods.name: setMemoryBacking
methods.description: Associates a memory dump with a backing type and object ID, specifically handling malloc backings.

methods.name: setDiscardableMemoryBacking
methods.description: Associates a discardable memory object with a dump, creating a memory allocator dump for it.

methods.name: getRequestedDetails
methods.description: Returns the level of detail requested for the memory dump.

methods.name: shouldDumpWrappedObjects
methods.description: Indicates whether to dump wrapped objects; returns false to avoid duplicates.
